from pathlib import Path

func='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    p1 = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, x in enumerate(row) if x == 1)
    p2 = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, x in enumerate(row) if x == 2)
    r, c = p1
    r2, c2 = p2
    dr = 1 if r2 > r else -1 if r2 < r else 0
    dc = 1 if c2 > c else -1 if c2 < c else 0
    # Travel diagonally, then make a right-angle turn along the longer axis.
    # Stop with the trail one cell short of the target's nearer edge.
    n = max(0, min(abs(r2-r), abs(c2-c)) - 1)
    for _ in range(n):
        r += dr
        c += dc
        out[r][c] = 3
    if abs(r2-r) > abs(c2-c):
        while r != r2:
            r += dr
            if (r, c) != p2:
                out[r][c] = 3

        while r != r2 and abs(r2-r) > 1:
            r += dr
            if (r, c) != p2:
                out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
